meta.tagline: Production-Grade Multi-Tenant SaaS Architecture & Security Engine
meta.description: An opinionated, production-grade architectural framework for AI Coding Agents and senior fullstack engineers. Enforces unbreakable tenant isolation on Next.js 16 and Supabase using PostgreSQL Row Level Security (RLS) as the hard security boundary, paired with an evidence-based development performance engine and Vercel-tested runtime optimization rules.

voice.tone: architectural, security-first, deterministic, evidence-based, unyielding on tenant isolation
principles: RLS is the security boundary; application code filtering is only a query-plan hint.
Service-role key never reaches client bundles or public endpoints.
Tenant context is resolved once at the edge and passed down explicitly.
Performance optimization must never weaken security, auth, or tenant boundaries.
Audit must precede optimization; every change requires DELTA benchmark evidence.

pillars.1_foundation: Multi-Tenant Scaffolding, Edge Resolution & ARCHITECTURE.md generation
pillars.2_security: 4-Policy RLS Patterns, Custom JWT Claims Hook & Membership Model
pillars.3_data: Shared Schema with tenant_id, Pluggable Query Layer (Supabase/Drizzle/Prisma)
pillars.4_application: App Router, Server Components, Server Actions & Route Handlers
pillars.5_quality: Automated RLS Coverage Audits, Security Testing & Leak Diagnosis
pillars.6_devops_perf: Development Performance Audit (13 Phases), Bottleneck Classification & Safe Optimizations
pillars.7_operations: Fail-Closed Recovery, Disaster Runbooks & Architecture Compliance
